name: KnowLine 31B Gen1.5
note: PelaAI's KnowLine-31B-Gen1.5 (Hugging Face PelaAI/KnowLine-31B-Gen1.5 @ 8e56aa1b236a6dd1064dcfd22ba1e5e360e4c140, Apache-2.0; dense, a LoRA fine-tune of google/gemma-4-31B-it merged into bf16 weights, byte-identical to KnowLine-31B-Gen1; readout temperature 1.44 folded into the weights) on our GPU through the repo's own serve_knowline.sh: SGLang 0.5.21 (transformers 5.12.1, torch 2.13.0+cu130) in bf16, --mem-fraction-static 0.85, --enable-fp32-lm-head, then the repo's knowline_server.py System One front end (served model name m, temperature 1, 16 scoring threads, read twice up to 3,000 tokens, question header and one read for longer text-only requests up to 32,768 tokens, temperatures.json; sha256 of knowline_server.py 6014957e, knowline_layout.py 2e839fa2, serve_knowline.sh 701e7e85, as the repo's SHA256SUMS). Label-token readout: one prefill per question, a softmax over the option labels; probabilities stored as returned. At most 255 options per question: longer play lists are split into equal groups of at most 255, as for every 255-option service. Nothing is truncated: SGLang runs without --allow-auto-truncate, so a prompt over its limit (min(context 262,144, KV pool) - 6 tokens) is refused (front end 422) and the decision fails. No hosted API and no list price: cost not recorded. Late entry to the original League 1 table (Ümit #4325); not eligible for the Hype Cup. One league match at a time (max_matches 1) and one decision in flight (parallel 1), so the server gets at most one request at a time, as it was handed over (Zeki #4561); from 2026-11-10 the first run's 4 parallel matches #933-#936 are void and replayed (Zeki #4564).
